newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shares end lower, telecom CTC slips.
newsitem.headline: Chile shares end lower, telecom CTC slips.

text.p: Chilean blue chips snapped a mini-rally to close lower with losers including telecom CTC, which sank on profit-taking after climbing over four percent Thursday, said dealers.
The bolsa is seen opening lackluster Monday due to the U.S. President's Day holiday, said Jaime Pena y Lillo, portfolio manager at brokerage Socimer.
"The market will be very weak with stocks moving on their own whim," said Pena y Lillo.
The 40-share index ended down 0.57 percent at 115.76 points.
